question: By what radiant power is the target woman engulfed?
premises: A portion of blazing rays arises from the circle of śakti
That radiant portion acts as the engulfing force
The target woman is made swallowed by it
inference: The woman is overwhelmed by a portion of the blazing rays of the śakti-circle.
plain_english: She is swallowed up by a portion of the blazing rays of the circle of śakti.
